Implemented type-safe SQL window functions, frame specification helpers, and named `WINDOW` clause support across all supported dialects on branch `feat/window-functions`.

### Summary of Changes

- **Window Functions & Frame Helpers ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts))**:
  - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L220-L222), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L224-L226), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L228-L230), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L232-L237), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L239-L241), and [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L243-L245).
  - **Offset / value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L247-L280), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L282-L315), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L317-L322), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L324-L329), and [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L331-L340) with nullable return types (`T | null`) and non-null inference for `lag`/`lead` when a non-null default is supplied.
  - **Window aggregates**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L342-L344), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L346-L348), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L350-L358), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L360-L368), and [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L370-L375).
  - **Frame utilities**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L105-L107), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L109-L111), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L56), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L57), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L58), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L60-L65), and [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L67-L72) with boundary order and argument validation.
- **Select Builders & Dialects**:
  - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` method and `WINDOW` clause compilation before `ORDER BY` across PostgreSQL ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts#L860-L878), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts#L405-L441)), MySQL ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts#L907-L925), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts#L389-L416)), SQLite ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts#L708-L726), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts#L369-L377)), SingleStore ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts#L780-L798), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts#L368-L389)), and Gel ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts#L853-L871), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts#L399-L435)).
- **Tests**:
  - Added unit tests in [window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts) and type tests in [window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-l65b6vw8/drizzle-orm/type-tests/pg/window.ts).
